candidates.name: KVP10k
observations: Repository describes annotations of PDF pages with image_url/page_number metadata and downloads original PDFs from those external URLs.
Paper section 3 describes Common Crawl and FCC PDF sources, not documented scanner acquisition for selected invoice originals.
The publisher card reports CDLA-Permissive-2.0 for its dataset; this review has not established applicable reuse/redistribution permission or scanner capture provenance for any selected external PDF.
candidates.decision: Candidate metadata/source discovery resource only. No selected originals qualify yet; per-document invoice/language/permission/capture eligibility remains to be established.
